title: Fix the layered config system (merge, expand, loader) to match its specs
prompt: This layered configuration system has three modules — merge.py, expand.py, loader.py — each with a module docstring that is the agreed contract. The implementations diverge from their specs in several interacting ways, and tests in test_config.py fail. Fix all three modules so every documented behavior holds: deep-merge semantics (None deletion marker, list replacement, no mutation at any depth), expansion semantics (defaults with colons, the $$ escape, recursive expansion through dicts AND lists, new containers), and loader semantics (later layers win, merge fully before expanding). Keep the spec docstrings intact. The tests encode the agreed-on spec and must not be weakened or changed. Run python3 -m pytest to check your work.
